title: Ordering a Drink and Snack
objective: Order a drink and snack, then complete payment
situation: You are visiting a cafe in the morning and ordering breakfast.
closing_display_text: You're welcome. Have a nice day too!
closing_spoken_text: You're welcome. Have a nice day too!

turns.assistant_display_text: Good morning. What would you like to drink?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Good morning. What would you like to drink?
turns.user_display_text: I would like a cup of tea, please.
turns.user_expected_text: I would like a cup of tea, please.

turns.assistant_display_text: Would you like it hot or iced?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Would you like it hot or iced?
turns.user_display_text: Hot tea, please, with a little sugar.
turns.user_expected_text: Hot tea, please, with a little sugar.
turns.arabic_hint: اختر الشاي الساخن مع القليل من السكر.

turns.assistant_display_text: Would you like something to eat?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Would you like something to eat?
turns.user_display_text: Yes, I would like a cheese sandwich.
turns.user_expected_text: Yes, I would like a cheese sandwich.

turns.user_display_text: No, thank you. That is all for me.
turns.user_expected_text: No, thank you. That is all for me.

turns.assistant_display_text: Your total is seven dollars. How would you like to pay?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Your total is seven dollars. How would you like to pay?
turns.user_display_text: I would like to pay by card, please.
turns.user_expected_text: I would like to pay by card, please.

turns.user_display_text: Thank you very much. Have a nice day.
turns.user_expected_text: Thank you very much. Have a nice day.
turns.arabic_hint: اشكر الموظف وتمنَّ له يوماً سعيداً.
